metadata.title: आदिवासी : इतिहास और परिभाषा | Tribal: Definition and History | XaXa Committee Report, EP - 1
metadata.description: Prof. Virginius Xaxa is a renowned sociologist, who with other members of his committee submitted a report on Tribals in 2014. This committee was also addressed as the Tribal committee of 2014. It is a comprehensive report which covers various aspects related to Adivasis. However, it has been 9 years since this report has been submitted still we rarely see any change or steps taken to amed the lives of Adivasis. Moreover, we are starting a series which will comprehensively cover this video which will help us to understand various concerns related to the tribals. We are starting with the question that is there a definition available for Adivasis?
